name: Utah Holiday Jell-O Salad / Peach or Strawberry Gelatin Fluff (Citrus-Free)
groceryIngredients: Canned Diced Peaches or Pears (in juice)
whyItWorks: A staple on every Utah holiday table: gelatin, mini marshmallows, whipped topping, and canned peeled peaches or pears are virtually fiber-free and soothe the gut.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy Peach, Cherry, or Strawberry Jell-O fluff made with canned peaches/pears and marshmallows; avoid versions made with canned Mandarin oranges (citrus) or seeded raspberries.
watchOuts: CITRUS CHECK: Skip Jell-O salads containing canned Mandarin orange segments or crushed pineapple in citrus juice
Skip Raspberry Jell-O salads made with whole seeded frozen raspberries
